description: Restart an existing app (rolling restart with zero downtime). Call this after changing configuration, or to recover an app that is stuck or misbehaving. It restarts the version already running. It does not build or pull new code: call rebuild_app for that. If this app has storage, it is stopped and started again instead, so it is unreachable for a few seconds.

app_id.description: The app id returned by list_apps

name: redeploy_app
title: Restart an app
